title: End-to-end serial-audio and clock contract is not proven
component_interface: TLV320ADC5140 to RT1062 to TAS5825M audio and clocks
description: The product names TDM/I2S and stereo I2S but does not freeze a supported end-to-end mode, mastership, sample/frame format, clock relationships, logic levels, timing margins or latency. Internal Board A and cross-board compatibility must be demonstrated before architecture freeze.

evidence.note: The named audio links are product intent; complete clock/protocol compatibility is not established.

closure_criterion: Before R3 PASS, use R2 authoritative endpoint evidence to approve one end-to-end ADC→RT1062→amplifier clock/audio contract, including master roles, rate/slot/frame formats, logic levels, loaded timing, startup and latency budget; decide MCLK inclusion by evidence and identify resource/DMA feasibility.
